definitions.explanation: The moral standards and behavioral norms of a community, school, or organization. Often appears in discussions about maintaining or disrupting order.

examples.japanese: {風紀|ふうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乱|みだ}す→乱す：11412_midasu⟧⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧だ。
examples.english: That's behavior that disrupts public morals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風紀|ふうき}⟦{委員|いいん}→委員：01708_iin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I was chosen as a member of the school's discipline committee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風紀|ふうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乱|みだ}れている→乱れる：09506_midareru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{服装|ふくそう}→服装：03594_fukusou⟧⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Since workplace discipline has deteriorated, it was decided to review the dress code.

notes:
Frequently appears in school and workplace contexts. Japanese schools often have a {風紀|ふうき}⟦{委員|いいん}→委員：01708_iin⟧ (discipline committee) or {風紀|ふうき}⟦{委員長|いいんちょう}→委員長：19385_iinchou⟧ (head of the discipline committee) — students responsible for enforcing rules on uniforms, behavior, etc. A common trope in anime and manga.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風紀|ふうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乱|みだ}す→乱す：11412_midasu⟧ (disrupt public morals/discipline)
- {風紀|ふうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}す→正す：10132_tadasu⟧ (correct/restore discipline)
- {風紀|ふうき}⟦{委員|いいん}→委員：01708_iin⟧ (discipline committee member)
- {風紀|ふうき}⟦{委員長|いいんちょう}→委員長：19385_iinchou⟧ (head of discipline committee)
- {風紀|ふうき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{締|し}まり→取り締まり：07445_torishimari⟧ (enforcement of discipline)
